title: Duplex receptacle count on a power plan
prompt: Power plan E-301 mixes three device symbols: duplex receptacles (a circle with two short parallel bars), wall switches (marked 'S'), and data/telecom jacks (a triangle marked 'D'). Count ONLY the duplex receptacles — do not count switches (S) or data jacks (D). Emit the total as a single quantity named 'duplex receptacle' in 'ea'.
